\title{Tiny Coreset Selection}
\author{Test Author}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We select a coreset of CIFAR-10 using EL2N scores.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
Training on all data is expensive.
\input{extra}
\section{Related Work}
GraNd and EL2N score examples early in training.
\section{Method}
We prune the training set with EL2N scores computed at epoch 10.
\section{Experiments}
On CIFAR-10, random selection achieves 83.2\%. Our method reaches 90.1\% accuracy.
\section{Limitations}
Early-training scores are unstable across random seeds.
\section{Conclusion}
Coreset selection with EL2N reduces data without large accuracy loss.
